/.title: Babbl: Private voice-to-text dictation for Windows, macOS and Linux
/.description: Babbl is a free, open-source dictation app that runs on your own machine. Hold a shortcut, speak, and your words appear in any app, with live text, voice refine and clipboard sync.

/download.title: Download Babbl for Windows, macOS and Linux
/download.description: Download Babbl, the free local-first dictation app. Installers for Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm).

/docs.title: Babbl Docs: Getting started with local dictation
/docs.description: Install Babbl, pick a speech model, set your shortcut, and learn about live text, refine, post-processing, clipboard sync and troubleshooting.

/changelog.title: Babbl Changelog: What's new
/changelog.description: Release notes for every version of Babbl, the open-source local dictation app.

/credits.title: Credits: Babbl is built on Handy
/credits.description: Babbl is a fork of Handy, the open-source speech-to-text app by CJ Pais. See what Babbl builds on and the open-source projects behind it.

/contact.title: Contact Babbl
/contact.description: Get in touch about Babbl by email, or report bugs and request features on GitHub.

/privacy.title: Babbl Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: Babbl runs on your computer and collects nothing: no accounts, no analytics, no telemetry.

/terms.title: Babbl Terms of Use
/terms.description: Terms of use for Babbl, the free and open-source dictation app.
